title: CodeChef: Roller Coaster
description: Chef's son wants to ride a rollercoaster. The minimum height requirement is `h`. If his son's height `x >= h`, return 'YES', else 'NO'.
constraints:
1 <= x, h <= 100
• Time: O(1) | Space: O(1)
starter_code:
def can_ride(x: int, h: int) -> str:
    pass
solution:
def can_ride(x: int, h: int) -> str:
    return 'YES' if x >= h else 'NO'
explanation: Checks condition x >= h in O(1) time.
